metadata.name: ParmanaAI Clinical Claim Verification Benchmark
metadata.description: Gold-standard verification benchmark for evaluating textual NLI, numerical consistency, and evidence-conflict resolution.

cases.claim: Hypertension is diagnosed when systolic blood pressure is at least 130 mmHg.

evidence.text: The AHA/ACC guidelines define stage 1 hypertension as systolic blood pressure between 130 and 139 mmHg or diastolic between 80 and 89 mmHg.

cases.claim: Aspirin increases mortality in patients suffering an acute myocardial infarction.

evidence.text: The ISIS-2 trial demonstrated that aspirin significantly reduced 5-week vascular mortality by 23% in patients with suspected acute myocardial infarction.

cases.claim: Beta-blockers improve survival in all patients with acute uncomplicated pericarditis.

evidence.text: First-line therapy for acute pericarditis consists of NSAIDs or aspirin plus colchicine. Exercise restriction is advised.

cases.claim: Type 2 diabetes is diagnosed with a fasting plasma glucose of 126 mg/dL or higher.

evidence.text: The American Diabetes Association criteria for the diagnosis of diabetes include a fasting plasma glucose level of 126 mg/dL (7.0 mmol/L) or greater.

cases.claim: Metformin therapy causes marked hyperglycemia in diabetic patients.

evidence.text: Metformin improves glycemic control by decreasing hepatic glucose production and improving peripheral insulin sensitivity.

cases.claim: Continuous glucose monitoring prevents diabetic retinopathy progression by 95%.

evidence.text: Continuous glucose monitoring provides real-time interstitial glucose readings and reduces time in hypoglycemia.

cases.claim: Inhaled corticosteroids reduce the frequency of asthma exacerbations.

evidence.text: Inhaled corticosteroids (ICS) are the most effective anti-inflammatory therapy for persistent asthma, significantly reducing exacerbation risk and hospitalizations.

cases.claim: Smoking tobacco protects against the development of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

evidence.text: Cigarette smoking is the primary causative etiology of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), responsible for over 80% of cases.

cases.claim: Albuterol inhalers cure underlying genetic cystic fibrosis mutations.

evidence.text: Albuterol provides short-acting bronchodilation and helps facilitate airway clearance in patients with cystic fibrosis.

cases.claim: Fever is clinically defined as a core body temperature of 38.0°C or higher.

evidence.text: A fever is considered clinically present when oral or core body temperature reaches or exceeds 38.0 degrees Celsius (100.4 degrees Fahrenheit).

cases.claim: Antibiotics are an effective treatment for uncomplicated viral influenza.

evidence.text: Antibacterial agents are ineffective against viral pathogens such as influenza viruses and should not be prescribed in the absence of secondary bacterial infection.

cases.claim: Vitamin C supplementation cures human immunodeficiency virus within two weeks.

evidence.text: Antiretroviral therapy (ART) consisting of multiple active antiretroviral agents is mandatory for suppressing HIV viral replication.

cases.claim: ACE inhibitors reduce proteinuria in diabetic kidney disease.

evidence.text: Renin-angiotensin system inhibitors (ACE inhibitors or ARBs) are strongly recommended to reduce albuminuria and slow CKD progression in diabetic patients.

cases.claim: Chronic kidney disease stage 5 requires no renal replacement therapy or dialysis.

evidence.text: Stage 5 CKD (eGFR < 15 mL/min/1.73m2) indicates kidney failure where renal replacement therapy, such as hemodialysis or transplantation, is essential to sustain life.

cases.claim: Eating blueberries reverses end-stage renal disease within forty-eight hours.

evidence.text: Patients with chronic kidney disease require dietary monitoring of potassium, sodium, and phosphorus intake.

cases.claim: Intravenous thrombolysis is beneficial when administered within 4.5 hours of ischemic stroke onset.

evidence.text: Intravenous alteplase is recommended for eligible patients with acute ischemic stroke who can be treated within 4.5 hours of symptom onset.

cases.claim: Thrombolytic therapy should be routinely administered to patients with acute hemorrhagic stroke.

evidence.text: Thrombolytic agents are strictly contraindicated in acute intracranial hemorrhage due to catastrophic risk of worsening intracranial bleeding.

cases.claim: Acupuncture resolves all neurological deficits in severe Parkinson disease.

evidence.text: Levodopa combined with a dopa-decarboxylase inhibitor remains the standard pharmacologic treatment for motor symptoms of Parkinson disease.

cases.claim: Statins lower low-density lipoprotein cholesterol by inhibiting HMG-CoA reductase.

evidence.text: Statins competitively inhibit 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-coenzyme A (HMG-CoA) reductase, leading to upregulated LDL receptors and reduced circulating LDL-C.

cases.claim: Warfarin anticoagulation decreases the international normalized ratio below 1.0.

evidence.text: Warfarin inhibits vitamin K-dependent clotting factors, thereby increasing the prothrombin time and elevating the INR to a therapeutic target range typically between 2.0 and 3.0.

cases.claim: Screening colonoscopy reduces incidence and mortality from colorectal cancer.

evidence.text: Screening for colorectal cancer with colonoscopy enables early detection and removal of adenomatous polyps, significantly decreasing colorectal cancer incidence and mortality.

cases.claim: Early detection of breast cancer via mammography increases overall disease-specific mortality.

evidence.text: Biennial screening mammography in women aged 50 to 74 years reduces breast cancer mortality by detecting tumors at earlier, more treatable stages.

cases.claim: Coffee consumption completely eliminates the need for surgical resection in pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

evidence.text: Surgical resection provides the only potentially curative treatment option for localized pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, followed by adjuvant chemotherapy.

cases.claim: SGLT2 inhibitors reduce hospitalizations for heart failure in patients with reduced ejection fraction.

evidence.text: The DAPA-HF trial demonstrated that dapagliflozin significantly reduced the risk of worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death by 26% in HFrEF patients.

cases.claim: An HbA1c level of 5.2% indicates severe uncontrolled diabetes mellitus.

evidence.text: A normal HbA1c level is below 5.7%. Levels between 5.7% and 6.4% indicate prediabetes, and 6.5% or higher on two separate tests indicates diabetes.

cases.claim: Proton pump inhibitors reduce gastric acid secretion by inhibiting the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme.

evidence.text: Proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) suppress gastric acid secretion by specifically and irreversibly inhibiting the hydrogen-potassium ATPase pump on parietal cells.

cases.claim: Helicobacter pylori infection is entirely harmless and never causes peptic ulcers.

evidence.text: Helicobacter pylori is a major etiological cause of chronic gastritis, peptic ulcer disease, and gastric mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue lymphoma.

cases.claim: Methotrexate is a disease-modifying antirheumatic drug used as first-line therapy in rheumatoid arthritis.

evidence.text: The American College of Rheumatology strongly recommends methotrexate monotherapy over other conventional synthetic DMARDs for treatment-naive patients with rheumatoid arthritis.

cases.claim: Uric acid levels below 6.0 mg/dL trigger acute gout attacks in asymptomatic individuals.

evidence.text: Gout attacks occur due to supersaturation and monosodium urate crystal deposition, which typically occurs at serum urate levels above 6.8 mg/dL.

cases.claim: A single dose of oral amoxicillin cures infantile hypertrophic pyloric stenosis.

evidence.text: Infantile hypertrophic pyloric stenosis is an anatomic obstruction requiring surgical Ramstedt pyloromyotomy after fluid and electrolyte resuscitation.
